description: Dale Cooper reaches out to Lisa Freeman — brief, low-key message noting he is a local contractor and if the AV impact task force wants informal perspective from the trades, he is available as a quiet resource. No commitment requested, no political posture. Just a door left open.

resources.detail: Voluntary informal availability signal to community task force via trusted contact

expected_outcome: Relationship with Lisa Freeman modestly strengthened. Dale positioned as a credible, low-drama voice from the construction trades within Lisa's network. No immediate economic effect.
